definitions.explanation: The relationship between cost and quality/benefit. Short for コストパフォーマンス.

examples.english: This restaurant offers good value for money.

examples.japanese: コスパ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{考|かんが}えると→考える：00856_kangaeru⟧、⟦こちら→こちら：00960_kochira⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{方|ほう}→方：01139_hou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦おすすめ→おすすめ：09746_osusume⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
examples.english: Considering the value, I recommend this one.

examples.japanese: コスパ⟦{最高|さいこう}→最高：02637_saikou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{商品|しょうひん}→商品：01436_shouhin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}つけました→見つける：01180_mitsukeru⟧。
examples.english: I found a product with the best value for money.

notes:
コスパ is an abbreviation of ⟦コストパフォーマンス→コストパフォーマンス：28635_kosutopafoomansu⟧ (cost performance), meaning value for money.

ORIGIN:
Abbreviated from English "cost performance."

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- コスパ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧: good value for money
- コスパ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{悪|わる}い→悪い：00908_warui⟧: poor value for money
- コスパ⟦{最高|さいこう}→最高：02637_saikou⟧: best value
- コスパ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{考|かんが}える→考える：00856_kangaeru⟧: to consider value

USAGE:
Very common in everyday conversation when discussing purchases, restaurants, or services. Often used when recommending something affordable yet quality.

RELATED:
- ⟦タイパ→タイパ：04741_taipa⟧ (time-performance): time efficiency (newer term)
- ⟦{費用対効果|ひようたいこうか}→費用対効果：noentry⟧: cost-effectiveness (formal)
